title: Schedule D Reporting of Tangible Assets Policy
notes: Found by web search on 2026-10-22; PDF opened. No adoption date in the document (uploaded March 2019 per the URL). Threshold and useful-life table on p5, read from the text layer. Building rows are whole-class only: Buildings 40; Building Improvements 40; Engineered Structures 40. No building-component rows; transcribed rows are the infrastructure classes. Shared template: RM of Moose Jaw No. 161, Resort Village of Mistusinne, RM of Shellbrook No. 493 and Town of Tisdale use one Saskatchewan table (Land improvements 15; Buildings 40; Building improvements 40; Engineered Structures 40; road construction 40 / repaving 15; bridges 40 / upgrades; culverts; airports; water infrastructure). Mistusinne's table even keeps provincial "Ferries" rows, which suggests it comes from a Government of Saskatchewan model policy. Moose Jaw No. 161 and Mistusinne print identical lives; Shellbrook (culverts 20, bridge upgrades 10) and Tisdale (water infrastructure 45) change a few values.
